# skycloak_cluster_security_logs (Data Source)

Recent edge-security logs (WAF, geo-blocking, rate limiting) for a cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_security_logs" "recent" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  limit      = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum entries to return.
- `search` (String) Full-text search filter.

### Read-Only

- `logs` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs))

<a id="nestedatt--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action taken.
- `country` (String) Resolved country.
- `message` (String) Event message.
- `method` (String) HTTP method.
- `source_ip` (String) Client IP.
- `timestamp` (String) Event time (RFC 3339).
- `type` (String) Event type.
- `uri` (String) Request URI.
